integrity: Analytic proof of universal contraction, cycle root counts, multipliers and rate; 3970 exact-rational and finite numerical assertions corroborate specified identities. Self-review only; independent validation has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for deterministic scalar strictly convex power losses with p>2 and zero-memory, denominator-smoothed Adam; arbitrary positive steps. The identified periodic orbits are symmetric sign-alternating cycles; neither all periodic points nor complete attracting basins are classified. The motivating primary paper full text was inaccessible, and historical priority remains uncertain.
title: Sharp saddle-node threshold and bistable cycles for memoryless Adam on superquadratic losses
